channel.title: Who grades the grader? Saeid Asgari's notes on judging agents
channel.description: Notes on evaluating and improving tool-using agents.

item.title: Your judge isn’t lenient or strict. Your rubric is.
item.description: Holding the judge and the outputs fixed, what the rubric asks for moved the pass rate on correct outputs from 2% to 98%. Swapping the judge model barely mattered.

item.title: Self-review erases what you taught your rubric
item.description: Four rounds of model self-review pulled two good rubrics toward the reviewer’s own standard. Only delete-only revision was safe.

item.title: Letting agents design their own evaluators: lessons from 20,000+ agent eval runs
item.description: Five findings from a matched, five-repeat benchmark of self-designed evaluators, ACE and a ten-label expert calibration on tau2-bench and AppWorld.
